baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative selects the favors at word 2, relates them to the dual addressees' Lord at word 3, and makes active falsification the predicate at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Concrete bestowals come from one who both owns and completes the two addressees; takdhib is therefore not missing information but actively assigning falsehood to what has been given and to its giver-relation.

activation_trace.role: The bestowed-favors sense supplies the objects whose reality and source are being contested.
Lordship as ownership and authority makes the favors relational acts, not ownerless goods.
Repair, nurture, and completion make bestowal an ongoing formative operation on both addressees.
Declaring a thing or its bearer false turns the question into an accusation of active misattribution.

changed_reading.before: Which blessings do you two deny?
changed_reading.after: Which concrete acts by the one owning and forming you both will you actively mark as false?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The line joins favors, the completing Lord of both recipients, and a verb whose branches include whether a charge is carried through.
baseline_models.mechanism: A favor does not only invite a correct statement; nurture equips the recipients for a response. Denial can thus occur when conduct makes the bestowed charge fail, even while the mouth concedes the gift.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors provide the enabling goods from which accountable action can proceed.
Nurture and completion supply the formative relation that makes a fitted response possible.
A charge proving true by completion or false by failure recasts denial as enacted nonperformance.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a verbal refusal to admit a blessing.
changed_reading.after: Denial may be the failure to carry the capacities supplied by nurturing favor into truthful action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: All three lexical anchors permit a juridical constellation: word 2 can evoke oath, word 3 covenant, and word 4 a charge that succeeds or fails.
baseline_models.mechanism: Beside the dominant favor-reading, the line can carry a faint covenantal register: pledged claims are bundled under the Lord, and the two addressees are asked whether they will falsify them in declaration or performance.

activation_trace.role: The oath-making branch gives the questioned noun a branch-distant register of pledged commitment.
A covenant bound like a gathered bundle supplies the institutional bond beneath the pledge.
The true-or-failed charge makes falsification test whether a pledged relation is actually carried through.

changed_reading.before: The question concerns a list of pleasant benefits.
changed_reading.after: The benefits also sound like pledged claims of a covenantal Lord whose truth is tested in the recipients' response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mercy opens a sequence in which recitation is taught and meaning is disclosed by speech or sign. The favors challenged at 55:16 therefore function not only as goods but as legible marks, while the recipients have already been furnished with means of recognition.

activation_trace.role: Mercy and tenderness establish the governing disposition from which teaching and bestowal proceed.
A distinguishing mark that guides to its object turns taught knowledge into an evidentiary function.
Reading and recitation supply the communicative medium through which marks are gathered and voiced.
Disclosing meaning by speech or sign supplies the recipients' capacity to make evidence explicit.
Active declaration of falsehood becomes culpable misclassification of disclosed marks.

structural_cues: 55:1-4 orders mercy, teaching, creation, and disclosure before the repeated challenge reaches 55:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, teaching, recitation, and disclosure; I infer that these make later favors readable evidence and denial a refusal of recognition. A live alternative is that the opening only names separate favors without making every later favor a sign.

changed_reading.before: The addressees simply refuse to admit that benefits exist.
changed_reading.after: They misclassify mercifully disclosed signs despite having been taught how to recognize and articulate them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The balance is both calibration between two things and justice, while diminishing measure is prohibited. Joined to the charge-performance branch of takdhib, the focus question becomes behavioral: a recipient falsifies favor by making relations underweight, crooked, or short.

activation_trace.role: Balancing and aligning two things supplies the relational calibration later demanded of the two addressees.
Justice and equity specify the ethical quality of a truthful measure.
Shortchanging measure supplies the concrete failure by which received order is contradicted in practice.
A charge made false by not carrying it through converts inequitable conduct into enacted denial.

structural_cues: 55:7-9 moves from a placed cosmic balance to plural imperatives against transgression and diminution.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calibration, justice, and short measure; I infer an arrow from created balance to the recipients' duty to embody it, so failed measure falsifies favor. The alternative is that balance is only a separate command and does not define takdhib in 55:16.

changed_reading.before: Denial is principally an incorrect claim about gifts.
changed_reading.after: Denial is also short-measuring the ordered relations those gifts enable, making the charge of nurture fail in conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding pair gives the dual grammar material content: a visible human formed from measured, resonant pottery-clay and a concealed jinn formed from mobile flame. One nurturing Lord addresses unlike constitutions together without erasing their difference.

activation_trace.role: Estimating and measuring a thing makes creation a calibrated formation rather than undirected production.
Dry clay that sounds like pottery gives the human side a bounded, resonant material profile.
Fired pottery completes the image of a shaped vessel-like human substrate.
The concealed jinn supply the second recipient class contrasted with visible humanity.
Flame and fire supply the mobile material profile opposed to shaped clay.
Nurture and completion unite the unlike recipients under one formative relation.

structural_cues: 55:14 and 55:15 are parallel creation clauses; 55:16 immediately switches to a dual possessive and dual verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two parallel creations, contrasting substrates, and dual morphology; I infer that the dual addressees are human and jinn and that common nurture spans their difference. The live alternative is a broader rhetorical dual not exhausted by these two species.

changed_reading.before: The dual addressees are an unspecified pair hearing a generic blessing question.
changed_reading.after: Clay-bounded humanity and flame-mobile jinn are jointly asked which acts of their one formative Lord either constitution can falsify.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same line repeatedly follows new disclosures. The non-dominant following/voice branches make that recurrence audible as an antiphonal response slot: each new unit calls for recognition, and denial is the point where response ceases to carry the sequence forward.

activation_trace.role: A voice following another voice supplies an antiphonal image for the refrain answering each preceding disclosure.
Following in sequence makes each recurrence a successor that carries prior material into the next response.
A charge that proves true or fails makes each repeated response a fresh performance test.
The dominant favors sense keeps the serial voice attached to successive bestowals rather than free-floating cadence.

structural_cues: The focus line is one of 31 identical refrains in the surah, with 30 non-focus occurrences distributed after changing content blocks.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recurrence plus branches of sequence and voice-following; I infer a call-and-response mechanism in which recognition must be renewed. The alternative is emphatic rhetorical punctuation with no implied answering voice.

changed_reading.before: 55:16 is an isolated rhetorical question about the two creation notices.
changed_reading.after: 55:16 is one response-beat in an accumulating antiphony, testing whether recognition continues as disclosures change.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two expanses are released to meet, yet a between-relation prevents transgression and permits hidden value to emerge. This spatial mechanism reflects back on the dual addressees: shared lordship need not collapse difference; truthful reception is coordinated relation under a limit.

activation_trace.role: Mixing and disorder supply the live risk created when two domains are released toward contact.
Two opposed things arriving together supplies the encounter that must be governed rather than prevented.
A connection standing between parties makes the boundary relational, not merely a wall of separation.
Crossing the limit through aggression identifies the failure the between-relation restrains.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the productive result of bounded encounter.
A single authority supplies the governance under which the dual recipients can remain distinct and related.

structural_cues: 55:19-22 repeats dual nouns and dual verbs, then places a singular boundary between the pair before a shared emergence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies encounter, a between-connection, non-transgression, and emergence; I map that architecture back onto the dual grammar of 55:16. The materially live alternative is that the sea pair is only another favor and does not model the addressees' relation.

changed_reading.before: The two addressees are merely counted together under one Lord.
changed_reading.after: They are a governed pair whose difference, contact, and limits can themselves disclose productive favor or enact denial.

context_deltas.mechanism: Everything borne by the created plane ends, while the Lord-facing source remains. The focus verb's branch of a provision failing expected duration now distinguishes two claims: a gift can truly be a gift without being permanent, and denial can arise from confusing transience with falsity.

activation_trace.role: Cessation and departure after a period of remaining set a temporal limit on created benefits.
Continuance supplies the contrastive permanence located with the giver rather than each given thing.
Face standing for the self locates abiding continuity in the Lord's own reality.
Provision that disappears after being expected to last supplies the exact false-expectation mechanism being corrected.
The favors sense preserves the reality of a temporary bestowal despite its ending.

structural_cues: 55:26-28 places universal created ending, enduring divine presence, and the same refrain in immediate succession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ending, remaining, and the refrain; I infer that finite duration does not negate gift-status and that expecting every gift to last can generate false denial. The alternative is a simple contrast between mortal recipients and immortal Lord without a theory of temporary favors.

changed_reading.before: A true favor should remain available; its loss makes the original claim doubtful.
changed_reading.after: A temporary gift remains true, while its passing redirects recognition from the provision's duration to the abiding giver.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unchanged refrain punctuates a sequence of weight, inescapable authority, exposure by marks, and seizure for wrongdoing. Under the focus root's authority-and-repair branches, a difficult possibility remains live: limit, warning, and consequence may be severe operations of lordly maintenance rather than exceptions to favor.

activation_trace.role: Weight and measure make the two recipient classes accountable rather than weightless observers.
Compelling proof supplies the authorized condition that defeats imagined escape.
Recognition through a mark reverses denial: concealed moral identity becomes legible.
Being taken to account for wrongdoing supplies consequence as the endpoint of exposed falsification.
Repair and completion permit, without requiring, a reading of corrective limit within nurture.
The favors sense poses the interpretive pressure created when the same question follows severe scenes.

structural_cues: From 55:31 through 55:45, the identical refrain repeatedly interrupts failed escape, cosmic rupture, exposure, and punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authority, proof, recognition, accountability, and repeated placement of the favor-question; I infer that protective limits or truthful consequence may count within nurture. A serious alternative is that the refrain contrasts these threats with prior favors rather than classifying the threats as favors.

changed_reading.before: Only pleasant provisions can be among the favors whose denial is challenged.
changed_reading.after: Even warning, boundary, exposure, and just consequence may be severe forms of the Lord's preserving order, though this remains exploratory.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fear of standing before the Lord leads into paired gardens and then an action-for-action maxim. This sharpens the baseline performance model: favor seeks neither bare assent nor equivalent repayment, but a fitting good act that lets nurture issue in ihsan.

activation_trace.role: Standing or remaining in a station supplies the accountable posture from which response is evaluated.
Meeting an act with its consequence supplies the reciprocal architecture linking received and returned good.
Ihsan as doing a good act specifies the quality of response on both sides of the reciprocal statement.
The charge proving true or false makes ethical response the test of whether acknowledged favor reaches completion.
The covenant image keeps reciprocity relational and binding without reducing it to commercial equivalence.

structural_cues: 55:46 opens the reward sequence with an accountable station; 55:60 closes its first movement by repeating ihsan on both sides of a question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accountable standing, paired reward, and act-for-act ihsan; I infer that the focus question solicits a lived good response to favor. The alternative is that 55:60 describes divine recompense only and adds no obligation to the recipients' recognition.

changed_reading.before: The adequate opposite of denial is verbal acknowledgment.
changed_reading.after: The adequate opposite is acknowledgment completed as fitting ihsan, with received nurture becoming enacted good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing blessing attaches stable, growing good to the Lord's name as a sign and to generosity. Read backward, the many favors in the focus line are not a disconnected inventory; each is a transient indication of an abiding, generous source.

activation_trace.role: Stable, growing good supplies an enduring source-pattern behind changing instances of favor.
A name as indication makes the closing name a sign that gathers the dispersed manifestations.
Honored generosity supplies the giving quality attributed to the abiding source.
Bestowed favors become the plural manifestations gathered by the final source-sign.
Staying and lasting reinforce continuity in the Lord-relation across changing gifts.

structural_cues: After the last non-focus refrain at 55:77, 55:78 closes the surah by blessing the name of the same Lord named in every refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stable good, name-as-indication, generosity, and the terminal reuse of Lord; I infer that the closing source-sign gathers the plural favors. The alternative is a liturgical close that does not retrospectively reorganize the refrain's objects.

changed_reading.before: The line asks the addressees to count separate blessings correctly.
changed_reading.after: Each plural favor is also a sign through which the abiding generosity of their Lord's named source becomes recognizable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins a plant-name branch to a dyed-cloth branch rather than translating the surface forms directly. It remains anchored in words 2 and 4 and yields a coherent appearance-versus-function test under nurturing lordship; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory material analogy, never as the lexical meaning of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun's attractive-but-bitter shrub branch and the focus verb's deceptive-cloth branch converge on the possibility that visible appeal misreports deeper effect.

activation_trace.role: An attractive-looking yet bitter-tasting shrub supplies a split between visual promise and experienced effect.
Variegated cloth that deceives by its condition supplies appearance itself as a vehicle of falsification.
Nurturing repair makes deeper formative effect, rather than surface pleasantness, the criterion of favor.

changed_reading.before: A favor is self-evidently pleasant, and denial simply refuses its pleasant appearance.
changed_reading.after: Some formative goods may look sweet yet taste bitter, while some apparent goods may deceive; the question tests recognition beneath surface display.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it depends on the non-dominant mapping of the focus noun to following, remainder, and last-breath images, then crosses into a failed-duration image for the verb. The exact focus roots and indices keep it anchored, and it coheres as a temporal reading; downstream prose should qualify it as a split-root resonance, not as morphology or a replacement for bestowed favors.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 2 admits remote branches of what follows, what remains, and the last breath, while word 4 admits a provision that fails an expectation of duration.

activation_trace.role: A remainder following what came before supplies the residue of favor left after prior gifts pass.
The last-breath image places the recognition test at the terminal edge of the recipients' duration.
Provision failing an expectation of continuance supplies the temptation to mistake ending for original falsity.
Staying and lasting set the temporal counterpoint against remainder and final breath.

changed_reading.before: The question inventories favors available in the present.
changed_reading.after: At the last breath it can also ask what of the Lord's giving follows or remains, and whether an ending will be misread as a broken promise.

strongest_changes: The opening teaching sequence turns favors into legible signs and denial into active misrecognition.
The balance sequence makes denial behavioral: short measure can falsify a received order in practice.
The clay/fire pair resolves the dual grammar into unlike recipient classes held under one formative Lord.
Finitude separates the truth of a gift from its duration and relocates permanence in the giver.
Exact recurrence activates an antiphonal reading in which recognition must be renewed after each disclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus line is lexically small but structurally generative: split mappings activate oath, sequence, answering voice, remainder, growth, and duration around the dominant favor-lord-denial reading. Whole-surah recurrence then changes a static accusation into repeated epistemic, ethical, material, temporal, relational, and liturgical tests without forcing those readings into one compromise.
remaining_uncertainties: The non-dominant mappings from ء ل و to ت ل و and from ر ب ب to ر ب و are activation cues, not claims about the surface derivation.
The dual grammar strongly fits human and jinn after 55:14-15, but may retain a wider rhetorical reach.
It remains open whether warning and consequence are themselves severe favors or are contrasted with favors by the repeated refrain.
The oath-covenant and appearance-versus-reality readings are coherent but deliberately branch-distant.
